Independent work / Document intelligence

Smart Procurement ERP Logging System

Turns bills, receipts, and invoices into procurement records with confidence-based review.

Status
Functional prototype
Context
Self-employed · Independent prototype
My role
Independent developer

Independent prototype. ERP integration tested against Odoo references.

01 / Context

The problem

Procurement documents require repetitive reading and manual ERP data entry.

My contribution

Built document ingestion, multimodal extraction, backend workflows, and ERP adapters.

02 / Workflow

Workflow

  1. Receive documents

    Upload APIs, email inbox watchers and external payloads.

  2. Apply ingestion controls

    Hash deduplication, antivirus scanning and quarantine.

  3. Extract document structure

    PaddleOCR and an 8-bit quantized 8B vision-language model.

  4. Evaluate and review

    Deterministic fallback filters, confidence scoring and manual review gates.

  5. Integrate with an ERP

    A ProcurementERP port and adapters; tested against Odoo references.

03 / Architecture

Architecture

API and validation

FastAPI APIs with Pydantic validation.

Document intelligence

PaddleOCR and an 8-bit quantized 8B VLM extract document layouts.

Persistence and retrieval

PostgreSQL with pgvector and full-text search; MinIO/S3 for documents.

Workflow and integration

Temporal coordinates processing; ERP adapters sit behind the ProcurementERP port.

  • Python
  • FastAPI
  • Pydantic
  • PaddleOCR
  • 8B VLM · 8-bit
  • PostgreSQL
  • pgvector
  • Full-text search
  • MinIO / S3
  • Temporal
  • Odoo references

04 / Engineering decisions

Controls and trade-offs

Separate extraction from acceptance

Confidence scoring and deterministic filters route uncertain extractions to human review.

Make the ERP boundary explicit

ERP adapters isolate target-specific integration logic.

Combine OCR with visual-language extraction

An explicit OCR and VLM configuration supports reproducible future evaluation.

05 / Status and evidence

Result

Functional prototype completed, including reference-based ERP integration testing.

Public code, demo, and performance benchmarks are not yet available.
